notes.title: Update - Launch Angle
notes.content:
If you need help, an option has been added for you to know the launch angle of the balls:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39862329/64ef13484e3bda24140dd8474d6fd7ac6785a8a0.png[/img]

This feature can be enabled in the menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39862329/7d173bd5c4567c4e4be888e7fa5ade3eeeda37a2.png[/img]
